input.summary: Deem every Development Cost-based termination payment by PB to be superseded by a single early-termination fee capped at three times average monthly Development Costs.
input.comment: [Playbook] The 300%/150%/100% and cost-plus-25% termination payments are liquidated amounts payable by us, however they are labelled, so we have expressly superseded them with one early-termination fee capped at three (3) times average monthly Development Costs, stated as the sole liquidated amount payable by PB. Approval Payments and all other commercial terms are untouched; our preferred position remains no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties, and this three-month cap is our fallback.

ops.text: Liquidated Amounts. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, each amount payable by PB under Sections 14.2.1 through 14.2.10 that is calculated by reference to Development Costs (including interest thereon and any such amount expressed as consideration for purchasing the Trial Data Package) is a liquidated amount, is superseded by this Section 14.2.11, and is payable solely as a single early-termination fee not exceeding three (3) times the average monthly Development Costs paid or incurred during the twelve (12) months preceding the effective date of termination, which fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by PB under this Agreement.
